question: Which single indicators and mechanism pairs improve existing geometric outcomes after an observed exit?
population: pos=0 and te>=0; endpoint-specific resolved labels; real and pseudo separate; all cells and six contracts retained
decision_information: dir known only after exit; old t0 covariates not refreshed; geometry/census as-of uncertified
families: log volume/time intensity and its change
family_additions: Exit delay and mechanism pairs added after initial 12-feature results were inspected, following explicit user additions. All expanded results are exploratory, not an independent confirmation. No operational threshold promotion.
models: cell historical baseline plus one covariate training-only quintile logodds adjustment; pairs use training-only tertile cross (up to9 groups). Clock uses historical category rates. Empty categories fallback to training prior. No hyperparameter search.
weights: equal sessions, equal contracts within session, equal t0 anchors within contract-session, equal rows within anchor. Duplicates retained, not independent.
validation: global chronological dates all6contracts; first40percent seed training; remaining60percent three forward blocks; one global-session embargo; no test labels fitted

endpoints.continuation: O2 one band height beyond exited edge before inside close; exclude exit bar; <=2000 same-session bars
endpoints.post_retest_exit_side: O3b first exit-side barrier versus inside-side barrier after future observed retest; retest bar excluded; <=2000 same-session bars

metrics: Brier reduction vs cell baseline; positive improves probability forecast, not profits
weighted AUC and increment vs same baseline
held-out diagnostic bucket rates; training edges change by fold, not an optimized entry rule
unavailable: total actual path length and exit-close displacement

export_semantics.amp: past200-bar high-low range at t0 in ticks
export_semantics.occ: fraction of last500 closes inside [L,H] at t0
export_semantics.vol_100/vol_occ: already natural log past100/past500 accumulated volume
export_semantics.dur_100/dur_occ: already natural log accumulated interbar nanoseconds, session-boundary gaps zeroed
export_semantics.h: H-L+1 declared band ticks, not actual exit distance

profiling: Raw parquet generic profiler unsupported; exact hash/footer validation and native selected-column profile used; generic projected CSV profiles previously checked. Source warning is unsupported parsing, not evidence of corruption.

distance_addition.measurement: existing mx_h: max observed exit-side high/low excursion from exited edge divided by h; exit bar excluded; until first inside close or bounded same-session window ends; includes return-close bar high/low
